# FG-AGENT-0015

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `update_refused_when_up_to_date` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このプロジェクトのエージェントの設定は更新できるものがありません（lock が無いか、もう新しい版です）。
- en: There is nothing to update in this project's agent configuration (no lock, or it already uses the newest versions).
- id: Tidak ada yang perlu diperbarui pada konfigurasi agen proyek ini (tidak ada lock, atau sudah memakai versi terbaru).

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 16 A9 (ADR-0032 Amendment A9): the agent builder's update (`GET …/agent-builder/updates`, `POST …/agent-builder/update`, the `agent.update_merge_request` job) found nothing to do. `reason`: `no_lock` (the default branch's tip has no `.gitstation/agent.lock.json` — build the configuration first), `up_to_date` (every locked part is already at its newest stable version that is not revoked, and the base model is the one asked for: the build would change nothing), `not_in_lock` (the job of a revocation: the project's lock at the tip no longer uses the revoked version — someone updated it already). Nothing was written. The job completes with it (logged as `forge.agent.update_skipped`), it is not retried.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The route's answer and log event carry `reason`, `project_id` and `request_id`; `gstn agent status --project <id>` lists the builds; `GET …/agent-builder/updates` shows each locked part's version and the newest stable one.

## 対処 (fix)

Nothing to fix. For `no_lock`, build the configuration once (`…/agent-builder/compile`). To move to another base model, ask the update with `adapter`.
